confirmedFindings.title: Async Port Release Signature Breaks Synchronous Callers
confirmedFindings.body: Making releasePort asynchronous breaks callers like sip_signaling_service/src/sipStateMachine.ts that call releasePort synchronously in destructor teardown handlers without awaiting the returned promise.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Keep synchronous releasePort or update all callers in sip_signaling_service to await the asynchronous deallocation.
